newsitem.title: USA: CGT says leak on 30-inch Columbia gas line.
newsitem.headline: CGT says leak on 30-inch Columbia gas line.

text.p: Columbia Gas Transmission Corp (CGT), a subsidiary of The Columbia Gas System Inc, said Tuesday it has a leak in northern Virginia on its 30-inch diameter natural gas pipeline.
It was not immediately known what volume of gas was lost as a result of the leak, which was discovered at 0800 EDT/1200 GMT earlier today, the company said.
"We have repair crews on the scene now," said company spokeswoman Alma Adkins.
She said it was too early to know when transmissions through the line could be restored.
The leak occured on the VC1 pipeline section running from CGT's compression station in Loudoun County, Va., she said.
-- H McCulloch, New York Power Desk
